description:
About OpenRouter

OpenRouter is the open AI routing and infrastructure layer that enterprises use to access, manage, and optimize the best large language models across providers—without lock-in, capacity constraints, or unnecessary cost. We power some of the most advanced AI teams in the world by giving them the flexibility to move fast, scale confidently, and stay future-proof as models evolve.

As enterprise adoption of AI accelerates, OpenRouter sits at the center of how organizations operationalize LLMs across research, product, and production workloads.

About the Role

As Scaled Partner Development Manager on our Ecosystem Partnerships team, you'll own and execute OpenRouter's strategy for growing our global network of LLM and inference providers after they sign and onboard. You'll be the team's first scaled partnerships hire, and you'll build the programs these providers use to grow on OpenRouter.

You'll manage a broad portfolio of model and infrastructure partners, run scaled growth programs, design marketing incentives, share insights that help partners grow, and expand their paid usage and model families. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Provider Operations, Marketing, and Finance so providers can scale distribution and revenue on OpenRouter. Your work will directly shape OpenRouter's product quality, partner growth, and economics.

What You'll Do

  • Grow and prioritize the provider ecosystem. Own the strategy for growing onboarded model providers, inference services, and accelerator-based platforms. Evaluate technical capabilities, performance, pricing, and customer demand to recommend which models partners should add and how they can grow. Build a pipeline of emerging model developers, cloud inference platforms, and GPU/ASIC providers ready to graduate to strategic partnerships.

  • Lead provider relationships at scale. Manage providers through shared programs, with one-to-one guidance when needed on roadmaps, pricing reviews, and growth planning. Advocate for provider needs and weigh them against platform performance, economics, and compliance.

  • Build scaled partner programs. Create growth programs that help providers reach usage and revenue milestones through demand insights, model recommendations, enablement, marketing incentives, and business support. Establish partner tiers, playbooks, graduation criteria, and recurring program reviews.

  • Drive revenue through partner growth and graduation. Build systems that surface growth opportunities, usage drop-offs, pricing gaps, and missing models or capabilities. Lead partners toward defined usage and revenue thresholds, and help those that qualify graduate to a dedicated Partner Development Manager.

  • Design marketing incentives and enablement. Lead co-marketing and incentive programs covering launch promotion, developer reach, and pricing, and own the results. Structure incentives that benefit both the partner and OpenRouter without risking reliability, margin, or compliance, and build enablement docs and processes that make growing on OpenRouter easier.

  • Measure what works. Partner with Finance to track provider revenue, incentive spend, and program returns. Build repeatable reporting and dashboards that show program impact across the provider ecosystem.

  • Partner across the company. Work with Provider Operations, Engineering, and Product on technical launches, metadata accuracy, reliability standards, routing logic, and supply expansion. Work with Growth, Support, and Marketing to communicate provider changes, outages, launches, and performance improvements.

  • Stay ahead of the market. Track the AI/ML and inference ecosystem, including emerging models, hardware accelerators, competitive pricing, and market shifts.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years in partnerships, business development, or strategic alliances, including 3–5+ years leading scaled or ecosystem partnership programs.

  • A strong understanding of AI inference and technical integrations, including API patterns, authentication, routing, data flows, rate limiting, and reliability metrics.

  • Expertise designing partner enablement, co-marketing, and incentive programs that drive adoption, usage, and revenue.

  • A highly analytical approach. You're comfortable digging into billing logs, token counts, performance metrics, and error patterns to find growth opportunities.

  • A strategic thinker who can build programs from 0 to 1 while managing day-to-day partner work.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence senior technical and commercial stakeholders.

If you don't meet every one of these criteria but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box, and we're looking for someone who is excited to join the team.
